```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using Duplicati.Library.Modules.Builtin;

namespace Duplicati.Tests.Library.Modules.Builtin
{
    public class SendTelegramMessageTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_ThrowsException_WhenBotIdIsNullOrWhitespace()
        {
            var sendTelegram = new SendTelegramMessage();

            // Use reflection to invoke private method SendMessageChunk
            var method = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetMethod("SendMessageChunk", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            // Set private fields m_botid and m_apikey to null or whitespace to trigger exceptions
            var botidField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_botid", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var apikeyField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_apikey", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var channelIdField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_channelId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var topicIdField = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField("m_topicId", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);

            botidField.SetValue(sendTelegram, null);
            apikeyField.SetValue(sendTelegram, "apikey");
            channelIdField.SetValue(sendTelegram, "channel");
            topicIdField.SetValue(sendTelegram, null);

            // Call SendMessageChunk and expect exception for botid
            var task = (Task)method.Invoke(sendTelegram, new object[] { "message", 1, 1 });
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(async () => await task);

            // Now set botid but apikey null to test apikey exception
            botidField.SetValue(sendTelegram, "botid");
            apikeyField.SetValue(sendTelegram, null);

            var task2 = (Task)method.Invoke(sendTelegram, new object[] { "message", 1, 1 });
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(async () => await task2);
        }
    }
}
```

The test failed because the SendMessageChunk method catches all exceptions internally and does not rethrow them, so no exception escapes to the caller. The test expecting an exception is incorrect.

Instead, I will write a test that verifies the behavior of SendMessageChunk by checking the log output or by verifying that the method completes without throwing, even when the bot ID or API key is missing.

Since the method is private and uses internal logging, I will write a test that calls the public interface that triggers SendMessageChunk, or I will test SendMessageChunk indirectly.
